title: 2001 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final
text:
{{Use dmy dates|date=October 2021}} {{Use Hiberno-English|date=October 2021}} {{Infobox football match | title = 2001 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final | image = | event = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 2001|2001 Munster Senior Hurling Championship]] | team1 = {{GG|Tipperary|hurling}} | team1association = [[File:Tipperary colours.PNG|40px]] | team1score = 2-16 | team2 = {{GG|Limerick|hurling}} | team2association = [[File:Limerick colours.PNG|40px]] | team2score = 1-17 | details = | date = 1 July 2001 | stadium = [[Páirc Uí Chaoimh]] | city = [[Cork (city)|Cork]] | man_of_the_match1a = [[Tommy Dunne]] ([[Tipperary county hurling team|Tipperary]]) | referee = [[Pat Horan]] | attendance = 43,500 | weather = Sunny | previous = [[2000 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|2000]] | next = [[2002 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|2002]] }} The '''2001 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final''' was a [[hurling]] match played on 1 July 2001 at [[Páirc Uí Chaoimh]], [[Cork (city)|Cork]], [[County Cork]]. It was contested by [[Tipperary county hurling team|Tipperary]] and [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]]. Tipperary claimed their first Munster Championship of the decade, beating Limerick on a scoreline of 2–16 to 1–17, a 2-point winning margin.{{cite web|url=http://www.premierview.ie/2000-2010.html |title=Tipperary Teams 2000-2010 |work=Premierview.ie |accessdate=23 June 2011 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110720185354/http://www.premierview.ie/2000-2010.html |archivedate=20 July 2011 }} Overall, this was Tipperary's thirty sixth [[Munster Senior Hurling Championship]] title.{{cite web|url=http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|title=Munster Final Winning Teams|work=Munster.gaa.ie|accessdate=23 June 2011|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721124423/http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|archivedate=21 July 2011|url-status=dead}} Tipperay had defeated [[Clare county hurling team|Clare]] in the semi-final by 0–15 to 0–14 to reach the final, while Limerick had defeated [[Cork county hurling team|Cork]] by 1–16 to 1–15 in the quarter-final and [[Waterford county hurling team|Waterford]] by 4–11 to 2–14 in the semi-final to reach the final.{{cite web|url=http://www.gaainfo.com/comp.php?co=intercounty&year=2001&comp=mshc|title=2001 Munster Championship Results|work=gainful.com|accessdate=23 June 2011|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120925142031/http://www.gaainfo.com/comp.php?co=intercounty&year=2001&comp=mshc|archivedate=25 September 2012}} The match was screened live by [[RTÉ]] as part of ''[[The Sunday Game]]'' programme.{{citation needed|date=October 2021}} ==Match== ===Details=== {{footballbox |date = 1 July
